test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_tags_cache_src ( metric_name String, unique_metric_name String, tags Map(String, String), empty_samples Array(Tuple(DateTime64(3), Float64)) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE ts_tags_cache_default ENGINE = TimeSeries SETTINGS tags_deduplication_cache_size_bytes = 268435456, recent_samples_ttl_seconds = 0, store_time_ranges = 0

CREATE TABLE ts_tags_cache_with_columns ENGINE = TimeSeries SETTINGS tags_deduplication_cache_size_bytes = 268435456, tags_to_columns = {{'job': 'job', 'instance': 'instance', 'namespace': 'namespace'}}, recent_samples_ttl_seconds = 0, store_time_ranges = 0

CREATE TABLE ts_tags_cache_custom_id ENGINE = TimeSeries SETTINGS tags_deduplication_cache_size_bytes = 268435456, recent_samples_ttl_seconds = 0, store_time_ranges = 0 TAGS INNER COLUMNS ( id Tuple(UInt64, LowCardinality(UUID)) DEFAULT tuple(sipHash64(metric_name), toLowCardinality(reinterpretAsUUID(sipHash128(metric_name)))) )
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_tags_cache_src SELECT concat('kube_pod_container_resource_', toString(number % 100)), concat('kube_pod_container_resource_', toString(number)), map( 'instance', concat('node-', toString(intDiv(number, 200)), '.prod.cluster:9100'), 'job', concat('kubelet-', toString(number % 8)), 'namespace', concat('ns-workload-', toString(number % 64)), 'pod', concat('service-deployment-', toString(intDiv(number, 4)), '-', toString(number % 1000)), 'container', concat('app-container-', toString(number % 4)), 'node', concat('ip-10-42-', toString(intDiv(number, 1000)), '-', toString(number % 250)), 'cluster', concat('prod-region-', toString(number % 4)), 'region', concat('region-', toString(number % 4)), 'env', 'production', 'service', concat('checkout-api-', toString(number % 32)) ), [] FROM numbers(200000)
INSERT INTO ts_tags_cache_default (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT metric_name, tags, empty_samples FROM ts_tags_cache_src
INSERT INTO ts_tags_cache_with_columns (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT metric_name, tags, empty_samples FROM ts_tags_cache_src
INSERT INTO ts_tags_cache_custom_id (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT unique_metric_name, tags, empty_samples FROM ts_tags_cache_src
